stories.title: Specialty Mapping Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define input/output contract for specialty identification including raw user query, normalized query, matched NUCC codes, confidence scores, and classification groups. Ensure compatibility with provider_search_models and downstream services.

stories.title: Core Specialty Identification Logic (Regex + Vector)
stories.description: Implement dual-pipeline specialty identification using regex matching and vector similarity in parallel, including query expansion and NUCC code aggregation and deduplication.

stories.title: Facade Integration for Specialty Identification
stories.description: Integrate specialty identification into FindCare facade flow, ensuring user input is processed and mapped to NUCC codes before provider search execution.

stories.title: API Exposure via Tool Router
stories.description: Expose specialty identification capability through tool_router with validated inputs and structured outputs for LLM tool-use, ensuring allowlist compliance and proper routing.

stories.title: Specialty Identification Tests and Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering regex matches, vector matches, query expansion behavior, NUCC code accuracy, and edge cases (ambiguous or multi-specialty queries).
